title: TRIAGE: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference Needs Both Reuse and Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34519v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are increasingly used for robot manipulation because they map camera images and a language instruction directly to actions. Robots that cannot be tethered to a workstation, such as mobile manipulators and humanoids, must run them on onboard embedded boards, where the prefill latency of the language backbone grows with the hundreds of visual tokens processed at every control step. To meet real-time limits, training-free accelerators recompute only a subset of the visual tokens and skip the rest, either by pruning them or by reusing their cached key-value (KV) states. The two options save nearly the same computation, yet existing methods apply only one of them to every skipped token. Through a token-level diagnostic, we show that which option keeps the action closer to full recomputation depends on the token's drift, the change in its shallow-layer value since its cache was computed. On both backbones

translated_title: TRIAGE：高效的视觉-语言-动作推理需要同时使用复用与剪枝
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因能将相机图像和语言指令直接映射为动作，正越来越多地被用于机器人操作任务。对于无法通过线缆连接工作站的机器人（如移动操作机器人和人形机器人），必须在机载嵌入式板上运行此类模型，而语言骨干网络的预填充延迟会随每个控制步需处理的数百个视觉token而增长。为满足实时性要求，免训练加速器仅重新计算一部分视觉token并跳过其余token，处理方式要么是剪枝丢弃，要么是复用其缓存的键值（KV）状态。这两种方式节省的计算量几乎相同，但现有方法对所有被跳过的token只采用其中一种。通过token级别的诊断分析，我们证明了哪种方式能使动作更接近完全重计算的结果，取决于该token的“漂移”程度，即自其缓存被计算以来其浅层值的变 化量。在两种骨干网络上……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TRIAGE，通过token级诊断发现被跳过的视觉token应根据其“漂移”程度自适应地选择KV缓存复用或剪枝，只有将两者结合才能在VLA实时推理中获得最接近全量计算的动作精度。
en_tdlr: TRIAGE demonstrates that efficient vision-language-action inference requires both reuse and pruning: each skipped visual token should be adaptively reused from its KV cache or pruned according to its drift (the change in its shallow-layer value since caching) to keep actions closest to full recomputation.
